definitions.de: Reduzieren, verringern, senken (eine Menge, einen Preis oder ein Niveau vermindern)
definitions.en: To reduce, to decrease, to lower (to make an amount, price, or level smaller)
definitions.es: Reducir, disminuir, bajar (hacer que una cantidad, precio o nivel sea menor)
definitions.fr: Réduire, diminuer, baisser (rendre une quantité, un prix ou un niveau plus petit)
definitions.hi: कम करना, घटाना (किसी मात्रा, मूल्य या स्तर को कम करना)
definitions.ja: 減らす、下げる、削減する（量、価格、またはレベルを小さくする）
definitions.km: កាត់បន្ថយ, ផ្ចិតផ្ចង់, ថយចុះ (ធ្វើឲ្យបរិមាណ, តម្លៃ ឬកម្រិតតូចចុះ)
definitions.ko: 줄이다, 낮추다, 감소시키다 (양, 가격, 수준을 작게 만들다)
definitions.ne: घटाउनु, कम गर्नु (मात्रा, मूल्य वा स्तर सानो बनाउनु)
definitions.pt: Reduzir, diminuir, baixar (tornar uma quantidade, preço ou nível menor)
definitions.th: ลด, ลดลง (ทำให้จำนวน ราคา หรือระดับน้อยลง)
definitions.tl: Bawasan, paliitin, ibaba (gawing mas maliit ang isang halaga, presyo, o antas)
definitions.ur: کم کرنا، گھٹانا (مقدار، قیمت یا سطح کو کم کرنا)
definitions.vi: Giảm, hạ thấp (làm cho lượng, giá cả hoặc mức độ nhỏ hơn)
definitions.zh: 减少、降低（使数量、价格或水平变小）
definitions.zh_Hant: 減少、降低（使數量、價格或水平變小）

definition_en: To reduce, to decrease, to lower (to make an amount, price, or level smaller)

lao_examples.lao_script: ຮ້ານນີ້ຫຼຸດລາຄາໃຫ້ຂ້ອຍໄດ້ບໍ
lao_examples.romanization: haːn niː lut laː.kʰaː haj kʰɔːj daːj bɔː
lao_examples.translation_en: Can this shop reduce the price for me?

lao_examples.lao_script: ຢາກຫຼຸດນ້ຳຫນັກຕ້ອງອອກກຳລັງກາຍ
lao_examples.romanization: jaːk lut nam nak tɔːŋ ɔːk kam.laŋ kaːj
lao_examples.translation_en: To lose weight, you have to exercise.
